title: Committed docs cite machine-local absolute paths and personal agent tooling
evidence: docs/silhouette-spec.md line 104: "- **Worktree:** `/Users/moses/.herdr/worktrees/packet-plumber/packet-plumber-v2-blender-silhouettes`" and line 10: "  `/Users/moses/code/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/packet-plumber-v2-design-audit/`"; assets/blender/README.md line 40: "(`/Users/moses/code/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/packet-plumber-v2-design-audit/`)." and line 44: "Tell the minion (or Gru). Fold-in = fill the SPEC table in"
detail: Committed docs point at paths outside the repo on the author's machine and author-specific tooling; the spec's 'sources of truth' are unreproducible from the repo alone and the references rot for any other reader or worktree.
recommended_fix: Copy the referenced audit/directions sources into docs/ (or cite repo-relative names), drop the absolute worktree path, and replace 'minion (or Gru)' with a neutral fold-in instruction.

title: gen_sprites.py docstring inverts its own determinism claim ('SPEC values at HEAD')
evidence:
Pipeline VALIDATED on Blender 5.2.0 LTS: re-running with UNCHANGED SPEC values
is pixel-deterministic — the pre-rework script (the SPEC values at HEAD)
reproduces the committed sheet pixel-for-pixel (decoded RGBA identical; only
PNG-encoder metadata differs). A no-op re-render is therefore golden-safe;
only COMMITTED geometry changes (new SPEC values) trigger the T2 re-bless
(docs/silhouette-spec.md §3).
detail: Post-merge, HEAD's SPEC values ARE the reworked ones (HOST_SIZE (0.85, 1.10) etc.), so re-running does NOT reproduce the committed sheet (sprites.json still holds the old bboxes). The parenthetical mislabels the pre-rework state as HEAD and will mislead the fold-in pass.
recommended_fix: Reword the parenthetical to 'the pre-rework script (the SPEC values before this rework)'; the determinism guarantee applies to a fixed spec, never to HEAD while PNGs are intentionally unre-rendered.
